clues.text: On "我的推广", the visible "新建推广" button can have a zero-sized accessibility rectangle while its live DOM rectangle is nonzero; if semantic press and plain DOM click fail, a full pointer/mouse event sequence on that uniquely verified button activates it.

The standard-promotion budget drawer opens from the row's info/description icon and contains controls for "高峰日上调" and "预算耗尽上调". Disabling either option opens a confirmation modal; confirm each one separately with "确定", then use the drawer's visible "保存设置" button to apply the changes.

On the standard-promotion page, open the promotion-time editor with the pencil edit icon beside the current time summary; clicking the time text or row may do nothing. The editor exposes a "全选" checkbox, a 7-day by 24-hour grid, and a visible "保存修改" button.

Switching to dual-platform bidding opens a confirmation dialog with "仍要切换"; afterward separate inputs are labeled "点评" and "美团". Enter and verify each decision value independently. Display may drop trailing zeros (for example, 1.30 appears as 1.3), so compare numerically.

In the promotion-time editor, grid cells ignore plain click() and need the full pointerdown/mousedown/pointerup/mouseup/click sequence. Rows map to hours 0-23 and columns to 周一..周日. Uncheck "全选", select the cells, then verify "已选择时段" matches the requested schedule before pressing "保存修改".
On the new-promotion page, the 极速推/标准推 cards are .promo-version__item; the selected card has a "checked" class. Activating a card needs the full pointer event sequence, not plain click().

In the merchant date-picker calendar, clicking the day cell (__cell) does not register; the selection only applies when the innermost .merchant-date-picker-panel-calendar-month__date-date node is clicked with the full pointerdown/mousedown/pointerup/mouseup/click sequence.

On the standard-promotion creation page, the "更多设置" row opens a drawer only via its pencil edit-icon inside .cc-more-setting-flat__value (not by clicking the row or label). The drawer shows 曝光渠道 selection and a 地域拓量 toggle with a 保存设置 button.
